open_questions_and_conflicts.issue: The user supplied a .md path, but only the .docx exists in the workspace.
open_questions_and_conflicts.impact: The DOCX extracted text is currently treated as the master specification; the missing Markdown path must be confirmed or supplied before implementation if it differs.

open_questions_and_conflicts.issue: The master spec offers alternatives (FastAPI/local MCP; FAISS/Qdrant; BGE-M3 or another local embedding) without selecting one.
open_questions_and_conflicts.impact: MVP dependency and interface choices cannot be finalized without inventing a requirement.
open_questions_and_conflicts.resolution_needed: Choose defaults during M0 approval, with local-only/no external service as the conservative assumption

open_questions_and_conflicts.issue: Acceptance thresholds are incomplete in places: capture harness, route accuracy, token reduction, useful-evidence rate, and local latency machine-specific.
open_questions_and_conflicts.impact: Some release gates cannot be evaluated numerically.
open_questions_and_conflicts.resolution_needed: Define thresholds and benchmark baselines during M0; retain <2s p95 as the proposed initial latency target

open_questions_and_conflicts.issue: Security says private data may use encryption/access policy, but key-management and threat model are unspecified.
open_questions_and_conflicts.impact: Private persistence cannot be safely implemented beyond metadata/policy stubs.
open_questions_and_conflicts.resolution_needed: Define local key source, encryption boundary, and threat model before private-data persistence

open_questions_and_conflicts.issue: Cross-profile write authorization workflow and Hermes event adapter contract are named but not defined.
open_questions_and_conflicts.impact: Integration and write-back behavior require an explicit interface.
open_questions_and_conflicts.resolution_needed: Inspect available Hermes integration surface or approve a sidecar-neutral event/MCP contract

open_questions_and_conflicts.issue: The specification names an initial profile set as alternatives: quant-researcher or coin68-editor.
open_questions_and_conflicts.impact: Profile fixtures and isolation benchmark need a fixed set.
open_questions_and_conflicts.resolution_needed: Select the third profile after general-assistant and developer

approval_gate: No milestone implementation, system-wide installation, destructive operation, full corpus ingestion, automatic injection, or deep Hermes-core change before user approval and resolution/acceptance of open questions.
